title: What a complaint must say
question: How much must a plaintiff plead to survive a motion to dismiss?

steps.note: A home-drawn complaint survives if it gives some notice of a claim.
Dismiss only if no set of facts could support relief.
No heightened pleading for discrimination; notice pleading still governs.
Plausibility replaces “no set of facts”; parallel conduct alone is not enough.
Plausibility applies to every civil case; strip conclusions, then judge the facts.
